title: DCS Cloud 对接配置
description: 连接您的 DCS Cloud 账号。请先登录 https://www.dcs.cloud/#/login ，在个人中心创建一个个人访问令牌(PAT)，复制后填入下方。PAT 仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传云端；连接器用它登录 dcs CLI，之后无需再次填写。
description_en: Connect your DCS Cloud account. First log in at https://www.dcs.cloud/#/login , create a Personal Access Token (PAT) in your profile page, then paste it below. The PAT is stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only and never uploaded. The connector uses it to log in to the dcs CLI; you will not need to re-enter it afterwards.
docLabel: 登录 DCS Cloud 创建 PAT
docLabel_en: Log in to DCS Cloud to create a PAT

fields.label: 个人访问令牌 (PAT)
fields.description: 登录 www.dcs.cloud 后，在个人中心 → 访问令牌页面创建并复制的 PAT（dcs_pat_ 开头）。
fields.description_en: After logging in to www.dcs.cloud, create and copy a PAT (starting with dcs_pat_) from the profile page → access tokens.
